`_readClassicSubstitutions` interprets entry offsets as signed and sets the first eligible glyph ID to `max(0, ceil(substOffset / 2) - offset)`. Consequently, every replacement word read starts at `2 * (offset + glyphID) >= substOffset`, for both negative and positive offsets; if no eligible glyphs remain, it reads no replacements.
